sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The "Incentive Scheme for Sericulture Reelers" is aimed at improving the financial condition of minority communities involved in silk reeling and spinning. The corporation will provide loans to support working capital and basic infrastructure for silk spinners.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Business & Entrepreneurship; Sector: Loan

**Detailed Description:** The "Incentive Scheme for Sericulture Reelers" was launched by the Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka, and is implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. The scheme aims to improve the financial condition of minority communities involved in silk reeling and spinning by providing financial assistance through loans and subsidies. This support is intended to enhance working capital, improve basic infrastructure, and promote better productivity and economic stability.
**Benefits / Assistance:** > **Financial Assistance:** - Silk reeling/spinning workers can receive a loan of up to ₹2,00,000/-, with 50% of the loan amount being provided as a subsidy.

**Application Process:** **Step-01:** Applicant need to visits the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation [official website](https://kmdconline.karnataka.gov.in/Portal/home). **Step-02:** Click ["Apply Online"](https://kmdconline.karnataka.gov.in/Portal/login) and Enter "Mobile Number" and "Submit". **Step-03:** Enter "Aadhaar Number" Fill in the "Captcha&quot
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation; Nodal Department: Minorities Welfare Department
**Tags:** Laon, Minority Community, Subsidy, Financial Assitance
